verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway and SaaS dashboard, so a built-in assistant that takes delegated tasks is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only routing, caching, analytics, prompt libraries and an MCP gateway for external coding assistants such as Claude Code and Cursor. Those external assistants are user-side integrations, not an assistant inside Requesty, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
